title: [podman-6.1] RPM: Allow RH image verification on Fedora and CentOS Stream
body:
Install RH sigstore and rekor keys, add policy.json requiring sigstore verification, and configure registries to fetch sigstore signatures using tag-based discovery.


(cherry picked from commit 8e008a04aaf13e829f4c750d2fe83667f6a9d08b)
